LoRA adapter (r = 16, alpha = 16) on vision and language layers, 16-bit
231 verified ROCOv2 rows: 208 for training, 23 held out. Images from the ROCOv2 test split, shrunk to 512 px. 3 epochs.
2–3 short, simple Bangla sentences: which body part and what problem. No treatment advice.
This is not a chat or question-answering model. The caption box takes the image\'s English caption, not questions.
Images are sent to a temporary Colab server, kept in memory only, deleted after processing. Do not use real patient images.
The server URL and API key are stored only on this phone and are not backed up.
Research prototype, not a diagnostic tool. The explanation may be wrong.
Trained on a small set (208 examples). It mainly learned the style of the Bangla answers, not medical knowledge.
Works best with the English caption. Image-only mode is weaker.
Runs on a free Colab GPU through an ngrok tunnel: slow, and it stops when Colab disconnects. Without an ngrok static domain the URL changes on every restart.
The server shrinks images to 512 px like training did. The prompt puts the image before the text, as the inference notebook did (training used text first).
The left/right check only compares the words left/right in the caption with the Bangla answer.
Bangla text uses the bundled Noto Sans Bengali font (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
